what.text: This page follows refugees from the State of Palestine living in Greece, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 11083 of these refugees in Greece, 22.9% of all Palestinian refugees that UNHCR counts.
Greece is the largest host in UNHCR's data, followed by Belgium, Iraq and Cyprus.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for this group, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1989 at 50 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 13988, at the end of 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Greece.
These are year-end totals for Greece only, reported to UNHCR.
